F_FADD                          ; Helper function: float add(float a, float b)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, Q16.16)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, Q16.16)
        ADD R0, R1, R0          ; add Q16.16 values
        MOVE R0, R6             ; result (Q16.16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

F_FSUB                          ; Helper function: float sub(float a, float b)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, Q16.16)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, Q16.16)
        SUB R0, R1, R0          ; subtract Q16.16 values
        MOVE R0, R6             ; result (Q16.16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

F_FMUL                          ; Helper function: float mul(float a, float b)
; F_FMUL: Q16.16 float multiplication with explicit sign handling
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C) as signed Q16.16
; Output: R6 = signed Q16.16 result
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (Q16.16)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (Q16.16)
        MOVE %D 1, R4           ; sign = +1
        OR R0, R0, R2           ; copy a into R2 and set flags
        JR_Z L2                 ; a == 0 → nothing
        JR_N L3                 ; a < 0 → negate
        JP L2                   ; a > 0 → nothing
L3                              ; negate a
        MOVE %D 0, R3
        SUB R3, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0
        MOVE %D 0, R3
        SUB R3, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L2                              ; a sign handled
        OR R1, R1, R2           ; copy b into R2 and set flags
        JR_Z L4                 ; b == 0 → nothing
        JR_N L5                 ; b < 0 → negate
        JP L4                   ; b > 0 → nothing
L5                              ; negate b
        MOVE %D 0, R3
        SUB R3, R1, R1          ; R1 = -R1
        MOVE %D 0, R3
        SUB R3, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L4                              ; b sign handled
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign on stack
        PUSH R1                 ; push |b|
        PUSH R0                 ; push |a|
        CALL F_MUL64            ; unsigned 64-bit product
        ADD R7, %D 8, R7        ; clean up arguments
        POP R4                  ; restore sign from stack
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L6                ; sign == 0 → result 0
        JR_SLT L7               ; sign < 0 → negate
        JP L8                   ; sign > 0 → no change
L6                              ; sign zero
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        MOVE %D 0, R1
        JP L8
L7                              ; negate 64-bit result
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, %D 1, R2        ; R2 = -1 (0xFFFFFFFF)
        XOR R0, R2, R0          ; LO = ~LO
        XOR R1, R2, R1          ; HI = ~HI
        ADD R0, %D 1, R0        ; LO += 1
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_NE L9                ; if low != 0, no carry
        ADD R1, %D 1, R1        ; carry to high if low wrapped
L9                              ; negation done
L8                              ; sign applied
        MOVE R0, R2             ; LO
        MOVE R1, R3             ; HI
        SHR R2, %D 16, R2       ; LO >> 16
        SHL R3, %D 16, R3       ; HI << 16
        OR R2, R3, R6           ; R6 = (LO >> 16) | (HI << 16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

F_FDIV                          ; Helper function: float div(float a, float b)
; F_FDIV: Q16.16 fixed-point division using 32-bit arithmetic
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a / b (Q16.16 format)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (dividend, Q16.16)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (divisor, Q16.16)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L10               ; if b == 0, return 0
        MOVE %D 1, R4           ; sign = +1
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_EQ L13               ; a == 0 → sign = 0
        JR_SLT L12              ; a < 0 → negate
        JP L11                  ; a > 0 → nothing
L13                             ; a is zero
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (result will be 0)
        JP L11
L12                             ; negate a
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0 (a_abs)
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L11                             ; a sign handled
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L14              ; b >= 0 → nothing
L15                             ; negate b
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; R1 = -R1 (b_abs)
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L14                             ; b sign handled
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L10               ; if sign == 0, result is 0
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign on stack
; 32-bit unsigned division: integer_part = a_abs / b_abs
        MOVE R0, R4             ; save dividend a_abs in R4
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; integer_part = 0 (quotient)
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; remainder = 0
        MOVE %D 31, R3          ; i = 31 (loop counter)
L16                             ; 32-bit integer division loop
        CMP R3, %D 0
        JR_SLT L17              ; if i < 0, done
        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; remainder <<= 1
        MOVE R4, R5             ; temp = dividend
        SHR R5, R3, R5          ; temp = dividend >> i
        AND R5, %D 1, R5        ; temp = (dividend >> i) & 1
        OR R2, R5, R2           ; remainder |= (dividend >> i) & 1
        CMP R2, R1
        JR_SLT L18              ; if remainder < b_abs, skip subtraction
        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs
        MOVE %D 1, R5
        SHL R5, R3, R5          ; R5 = 1 << i
        OR R0, R5, R0           ; integer_part |= (1 << i)
L18                             ; skip subtraction
        SUB R3, %D 1, R3        ; i--
        JR L16                  ; continue loop
L17                             ; integer division done
; 16-step fractional refinement loop
        MOVE %D 0, R3           ; frac = 0 (fractional accumulator)
        MOVE %D 0, R5           ; i = 0 (loop counter)
L19                             ; fractional refinement loop
        CMP R5, %D 16
        JR_SGE L20              ; if i >= 16, done
        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; remainder <<= 1
        SHL R3, %D 1, R3        ; frac <<= 1
        CMP R2, R1
        JR_SLT L21              ; if remainder < b_abs, skip subtraction
        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs
        OR R3, %D 1, R3         ; frac |= 1
L21                             ; skip subtraction
        ADD R5, %D 1, R5        ; i++
        JR L19                  ; continue loop
L20                             ; fractional loop done
; Combine integer_part and frac into Q16.16 result
        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; integer_part <<= 16
        OR R0, R3, R0           ; result_abs = (integer_part << 16) | frac
; Apply sign to result
        POP R4                  ; restore sign from stack
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L22               ; sign == 0 → result 0
        JR_SLT L23              ; sign < 0 → negate
        JP L24                  ; sign > 0 → no change
L22                             ; sign zero
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        JP L24
L23                             ; negate result
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0
L24                             ; sign applied
        MOVE R0, R6             ; return value in R6
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return
L10                             ; division by zero or dividend is zero
        MOVE %D 0, R6           ; return 0 for division by zero or zero dividend
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

; Helper functions for multiplication and division

F_MUL                           ; Helper function: int mul(int a, int b)
; F_MUL: signed 32-bit integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a * b
; Algorithm: binary shift-and-add (Russian peasant), O(32) steps
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, pushed last, first parameter)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, pushed first, second parameter)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L25               ; if b == 0, return 0
L26                             ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (positive)
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_SGE L27              ; if a >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; a = -a
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L27                             ; skip negate a
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L28              ; if b >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; b = -b
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L28                             ; skip negate b
; Binary shift-and-add multiplication (Russian peasant algorithm)
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign flag on stack
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; acc = 0 (accumulator)
L29                             ; binary multiplication loop
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L30               ; if b == 0, exit loop
        AND R1, %D 1, R3        ; R3 = b & 1
        CMP R3, %D 0
        JR_EQ L31               ; if (b & 1) == 0, skip add
        ADD R2, R0, R2          ; acc += a
L31                             ; skip add
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; a <<= 1
        SHR R1, %D 1, R1        ; b >>= 1
        JR L29                  ; continue loop
L30                             ; loop done, apply sign
        POP R4                  ; restore sign flag
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L32               ; if sign == 0, result is positive
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        SUB R0, R2, R2          ; acc = -acc
        JP L32                  ; result ready
L25                             ; zero multiplier
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; result 0 for zero multiplier
L32                             ; end multiplication
        MOVE R2, R6             ; result
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

F_MUL64                         ; Helper function: 64-bit unsigned multiplication
; F_MUL64: 64-bit unsigned integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C) (both assumed non-negative)
; Output: R1 = high 32 bits, R0 = low 32 bits, R6 = copy of R0
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (int32, unsigned)
        LOAD R2, (R5+0C)        ; b (int32, unsigned)
        CMP R2, %D 0
        JR_NE L33               ; if b != 0, continue
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; LO = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R1           ; HI = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R6           ; low 32 bits copy
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller
L33                             ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R1           ; M_HI = 0 (high 32 bits of multiplicand)
        MOVE %D 0, R3           ; ACC_LO = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; ACC_HI = 0
L34                             ; 64-bit multiplication loop
        CMP R2, %D 0
        JR_EQ L37               ; if B == 0, exit loop
        AND R2, %D 1, R6        ; R6 = B & 1
        CMP R6, %D 0
        JR_EQ L35               ; if (B & 1) == 0, skip add
        ADD R3, R0, R6          ; R6 = ACC_LO + M_LO
        CMP R6, R3
        JR_SGE L36              ; if no carry, skip increment
        ADD R4, %D 1, R4        ; ACC_HI += 1
L36                             ; no carry
        MOVE R6, R3             ; ACC_LO = temp_lo
        ADD R4, R1, R4          ; ACC_HI = ACC_HI + M_HI
L35                             ; skip add
        MOVE R0, R6             ; save old M_LO
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; M_LO <<= 1
        SHR R6, %D 31, R6       ; R6 = (old M_LO >> 31) & 1 (carry bit)
        SHL R1, %D 1, R1        ; M_HI <<= 1
        OR R1, R6, R1           ; M_HI |= carry_from_LO
        SHR R2, %D 1, R2        ; B >>= 1
        JR L34                  ; continue loop
L37                             ; multiplication done
        MOVE R3, R0             ; LO → R0
        MOVE R4, R1             ; HI → R1
        MOVE R0, R6             ; low 32 bits copy for compatibility
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

F_FDIV                          ; Helper function: float div(float a, float b)
; F_FDIV: Q16.16 fixed-point division using 32-bit arithmetic
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a / b (Q16.16 format)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer

        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (divisor, Q16.16)

        MOVE %D 1, R5

        OR R0, R5, R0           ; integer_part |= (1 << i)
L10                             ; skip subtraction
        SUB R3, %D 1, R3        ; i--
        JR L8                   ; continue loop
L9                              ; integer division done
; 16-step fractional refinement loop

L11                             ; fractional refinement loop

        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; remainder <<= 1

        CMP R2, R1

        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs

L12                             ; fractional loop done

L16                             ; sign applied

        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return
L2                              ; division by zero or dividend is zero

        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs

        OR R0, R3, R0           ; result_abs = (integer_part << 16) | frac

        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer

F_MUL                           ; Helper function: int mul(int a, int b)
; F_MUL: signed 32-bit integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a * b
; Algorithm: binary shift-and-add (Russian peasant), O(32) steps
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (left operand, pushed last, first parameter)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (right operand, pushed first, second parameter)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L26               ; if b == 0, return 0
L27                             ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (positive)
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_SGE L28              ; if a >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; a = -a
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L28                             ; skip negate a
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L29              ; if b >= 0, skip negation
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; b = -b
        XOR R4, %D 1, R4        ; sign ^= 1
L29                             ; skip negate b
; Binary shift-and-add multiplication (Russian peasant algorithm)
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign flag on stack
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; acc = 0 (accumulator)
L30                             ; binary multiplication loop
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L31               ; if b == 0, exit loop
        AND R1, %D 1, R3        ; R3 = b & 1
        CMP R3, %D 0
        JR_EQ L32               ; if (b & 1) == 0, skip add
        ADD R2, R0, R2          ; acc += a
L32                             ; skip add
        SHL R0, %D 1, R0        ; a <<= 1
        SHR R1, %D 1, R1        ; b >>= 1
        JR L30                  ; continue loop
L31                             ; loop done, apply sign
        POP R4                  ; restore sign flag
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L33               ; if sign == 0, result is positive
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        SUB R0, R2, R2          ; acc = -acc
        JP L33                  ; result ready
L26                             ; zero multiplier
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; result 0 for zero multiplier
L33                             ; end multiplication
        MOVE R2, R6             ; result
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

F_MUL64                         ; Helper function: 64-bit unsigned multiplication
; F_MUL64: 64-bit unsigned integer multiplication
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C) (both assumed non-negative)
; Output: R1 = high 32 bits, R0 = low 32 bits, R6 = copy of R0

        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (int32, unsigned)
        LOAD R2, (R5+0C)        ; b (int32, unsigned)
        CMP R2, %D 0
        JR_NE L34               ; if b != 0, continue
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; LO = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R1           ; HI = 0

        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller
L34                             ; continue multiplication
        MOVE %D 0, R1           ; M_HI = 0 (high 32 bits of multiplicand)
        MOVE %D 0, R3           ; ACC_LO = 0
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; ACC_HI = 0

        CMP R6, %D 0

        ADD R3, R0, R6          ; R6 = ACC_LO + M_LO

        SHR R2, %D 1, R2        ; B >>= 1
        JR L35                  ; continue loop
L38                             ; multiplication done
        MOVE R3, R0             ; LO → R0
        MOVE R4, R1             ; HI → R1

        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

        CALL F_MAIN             ; call main
        HALT                    ; end of program, R6 holds return value

; Function definitions
F_MAIN                          ; Function main
; Local variable a at (R5-04)
; Local variable b at (R5-08)
; Local variable result at (R5-0C)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        SUB R7, %D 12, R7       ; allocate 3 local variables
; Compound statement
; Local variable declarations
; Local variable a at (R5-04) with initializer

        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; shift hi part left by 16
        STORE R0, (R5-04)       ; initialize a
; Local variable b at (R5-08) with initializer
        MOVE %D 4, R0           ; load constant 4
        STORE R0, (R5-08)       ; initialize b
; Local variable result at (R5-0C) with initializer
        LOAD R0, (R5-04)        ; load variable a
        PUSH R0                 ; save left operand
        LOAD R0, (R5-08)        ; load variable b

        CALL F_I2F              ; convert int to float
        ADD R7, %D 4, R7        ; cleanup argument
        MOVE R6, R0             ; move float result to R0
        MOVE R0, R1             ; right operand to R1
        POP R0                  ; restore left operand
        PUSH R1                 ; push second arg
        PUSH R0                 ; push first arg
        CALL F_FDIV             ; call F_FDIV
        ADD R7, %D 8, R7        ; cleanup arguments
        MOVE R6, R0             ; move result to R0
        STORE R0, (R5-0C)       ; initialize result
        LOAD R0, (R5-0C)        ; load variable result
        MOVE R0, R6             ; return value
        JP L1                   ; jump to function exit
L1                              ; function exit
        ADD R7, %D 12, R7       ; deallocate local variables
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

; Global variables

; Float helper functions (IEEE-754 single-precision)

F_FDIV                          ; Helper function: float div(float a, float b)
; F_FDIV: Q16.16 fixed-point division using 32-bit arithmetic
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a / b (Q16.16 format)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (dividend, Q16.16)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (divisor, Q16.16)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L2                ; if b == 0, return 0
        MOVE %D 1, R4           ; sign = +1
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_EQ L5                ; a == 0 → sign = 0
        JR_SLT L4               ; a < 0 → negate
        JP L3                   ; a > 0 → nothing
L5                              ; a is zero
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (result will be 0)
        JP L3
L4                              ; negate a
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0 (a_abs)
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L3                              ; a sign handled
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L6               ; b >= 0 → nothing
L7                              ; negate b
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; R1 = -R1 (b_abs)
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L6                              ; b sign handled
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L2                ; if sign == 0, result is 0
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign on stack
; 32-bit unsigned division: integer_part = a_abs / b_abs
        MOVE R0, R4             ; save dividend a_abs in R4
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; integer_part = 0 (quotient)
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; remainder = 0
        MOVE %D 31, R3          ; i = 31 (loop counter)
L8                              ; 32-bit integer division loop
        CMP R3, %D 0
        JR_SLT L9               ; if i < 0, done
        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; remainder <<= 1
        MOVE R4, R5             ; temp = dividend
        SHR R5, R3, R5          ; temp = dividend >> i
        AND R5, %D 1, R5        ; temp = (dividend >> i) & 1
        OR R2, R5, R2           ; remainder |= (dividend >> i) & 1
        CMP R2, R1
        JR_SLT L10              ; if remainder < b_abs, skip subtraction
        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs
        MOVE %D 1, R5
        SHL R5, R3, R5          ; R5 = 1 << i
        OR R0, R5, R0           ; integer_part |= (1 << i)
L10                             ; skip subtraction
        SUB R3, %D 1, R3        ; i--
        JR L8                   ; continue loop
L9                              ; integer division done
; 16-step fractional refinement loop
        MOVE %D 0, R3           ; frac = 0 (fractional accumulator)
        MOVE %D 0, R5           ; i = 0 (loop counter)
L11                             ; fractional refinement loop
        CMP R5, %D 16
        JR_SGE L12              ; if i >= 16, done
        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; remainder <<= 1
        SHL R3, %D 1, R3        ; frac <<= 1
        CMP R2, R1
        JR_SLT L13              ; if remainder < b_abs, skip subtraction
        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs
        OR R3, %D 1, R3         ; frac |= 1
L13                             ; skip subtraction
        ADD R5, %D 1, R5        ; i++
        JR L11                  ; continue loop
L12                             ; fractional loop done
; Combine integer_part and frac into Q16.16 result
        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; integer_part <<= 16
        OR R0, R3, R0           ; result_abs = (integer_part << 16) | frac
; Apply sign to result
        POP R4                  ; restore sign from stack
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L14               ; sign == 0 → result 0
        JR_SLT L15              ; sign < 0 → negate
        JP L16                  ; sign > 0 → no change
L14                             ; sign zero
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        JP L16
L15                             ; negate result
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0
L16                             ; sign applied
        MOVE R0, R6             ; return value in R6
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return
L2                              ; division by zero or dividend is zero
        MOVE %D 0, R6           ; return 0 for division by zero or zero dividend
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

F_I2F                           ; Helper function: float intToFloat(int value)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; integer value
        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; multiply by 65536 to get Q16.16
        MOVE R0, R6             ; result (Q16.16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

        MOVE 40000, R7          ; init stack pointer
        CALL F_MAIN             ; call main
        HALT                    ; end of program, R6 holds return value

; Function definitions
F_MAIN                          ; Function main
; Local variable a at (R5-04)
; Local variable b at (R5-08)
; Local variable result at (R5-0C)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP -> base of frame
        SUB R7, %D 12, R7       ; allocate 3 local variables
; Compound statement
; Local variable declarations
; Local variable a at (R5-04) with initializer
        MOVE %D 15, R0          ; load constant 15
        STORE R0, (R5-04)       ; initialize a
; Local variable b at (R5-08) with initializer
        MOVE %D 196608, R0      ; load float constant 3.0 (Q16.16)
        STORE R0, (R5-08)       ; initialize b
; Local variable result at (R5-0C) with initializer
        LOAD R0, (R5-04)        ; load variable a

        CALL F_I2F              ; convert int to float
        ADD R7, %D 4, R7        ; cleanup argument
        MOVE R6, R0             ; move float result to R0
        PUSH R0                 ; save left operand
        LOAD R0, (R5-08)        ; load variable b

        POP R0                  ; restore left operand
        PUSH R1                 ; push second arg
        PUSH R0                 ; push first arg
        CALL F_FDIV             ; call F_FDIV
        ADD R7, %D 8, R7        ; cleanup arguments
        MOVE R6, R0             ; move result to R0
        STORE R0, (R5-0C)       ; initialize result
        LOAD R0, (R5-0C)        ; load variable result
        MOVE R0, R6             ; return value
        JP L1                   ; jump to function exit
L1                              ; function exit
        ADD R7, %D 12, R7       ; deallocate local variables
        POP R5                  ; restore old frame pointer
        RET                     ; return to caller

; Global variables

; Float helper functions (IEEE-754 single-precision)

F_FDIV                          ; Helper function: float div(float a, float b)
; F_FDIV: Q16.16 fixed-point division using 32-bit arithmetic
; Input:  a at (R5+08), b at (R5+0C)
; Output: R6 = a / b (Q16.16 format)
        PUSH R5                 ; save old frame pointer
        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP
        LOAD R0, (R5+08)        ; a (dividend, Q16.16)
        LOAD R1, (R5+0C)        ; b (divisor, Q16.16)
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_EQ L2                ; if b == 0, return 0
        MOVE %D 1, R4           ; sign = +1
        CMP R0, %D 0
        JR_EQ L5                ; a == 0 → sign = 0
        JR_SLT L4               ; a < 0 → negate
        JP L3                   ; a > 0 → nothing
L5                              ; a is zero
        MOVE %D 0, R4           ; sign = 0 (result will be 0)
        JP L3
L4                              ; negate a
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0 (a_abs)
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L3                              ; a sign handled
        CMP R1, %D 0
        JR_SGE L6               ; b >= 0 → nothing
L7                              ; negate b
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R1, R1          ; R1 = -R1 (b_abs)
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R4, R4          ; sign = -sign
L6                              ; b sign handled
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L2                ; if sign == 0, result is 0
        PUSH R4                 ; save sign on stack
; 32-bit unsigned division: integer_part = a_abs / b_abs
        MOVE R0, R4             ; save dividend a_abs in R4
        MOVE %D 0, R0           ; integer_part = 0 (quotient)
        MOVE %D 0, R2           ; remainder = 0
        MOVE %D 31, R3          ; i = 31 (loop counter)
L8                              ; 32-bit integer division loop
        CMP R3, %D 0
        JR_SLT L9               ; if i < 0, done
        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; remainder <<= 1
        MOVE R4, R5             ; temp = dividend
        SHR R5, R3, R5          ; temp = dividend >> i
        AND R5, %D 1, R5        ; temp = (dividend >> i) & 1
        OR R2, R5, R2           ; remainder |= (dividend >> i) & 1
        CMP R2, R1
        JR_SLT L10              ; if remainder < b_abs, skip subtraction
        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs
        MOVE %D 1, R5
        SHL R5, R3, R5          ; R5 = 1 << i
        OR R0, R5, R0           ; integer_part |= (1 << i)
L10                             ; skip subtraction
        SUB R3, %D 1, R3        ; i--
        JR L8                   ; continue loop
L9                              ; integer division done
; 16-step fractional refinement loop
        MOVE %D 0, R3           ; frac = 0 (fractional accumulator)
        MOVE %D 0, R5           ; i = 0 (loop counter)

        CMP R5, %D 16

        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; remainder <<= 1
        SHL R3, %D 1, R3        ; frac <<= 1
        CMP R2, R1
        JR_SLT L13              ; if remainder < b_abs, skip subtraction
        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs
        OR R3, %D 1, R3         ; frac |= 1
L13                             ; skip subtraction
        ADD R5, %D 1, R5        ; i++

L12                             ; fractional loop done
; Combine integer_part and frac into Q16.16 result
        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; integer_part <<= 16
        OR R0, R3, R0           ; result_abs = (integer_part << 16) | frac

        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L14               ; sign == 0 → result 0
        JR_SLT L15              ; sign < 0 → negate
        JP L16                  ; sign > 0 → no change
L14                             ; sign zero

        JP L16
L15                             ; negate result
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0
L16                             ; sign applied
        MOVE R0, R6             ; return value in R6
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return
L2                              ; division by zero or dividend is zero
        MOVE %D 0, R6           ; return 0 for division by zero or zero dividend
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

F_I2F                           ; Helper function: float intToFloat(int value)

        MOVE R7, R5             ; R5 = current SP

        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; multiply by 65536 to get Q16.16
        MOVE R0, R6             ; result (Q16.16)
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return

        CMP R5, %D 16
        JR_SGE L12              ; if i >= 16, done
        SHL R2, %D 1, R2        ; remainder <<= 1
        SHL R3, %D 1, R3        ; frac <<= 1
        CMP R2, R1
        JR_SLT L13              ; if remainder < b_abs, skip subtraction
        SUB R2, R1, R2          ; remainder -= b_abs
        OR R3, %D 1, R3         ; frac |= 1
L13                             ; skip subtraction
        ADD R5, %D 1, R5        ; i++
        JR L11                  ; continue loop
L12                             ; fractional loop done
; Combine integer_part and frac into Q16.16 result
        SHL R0, %D 16, R0       ; integer_part <<= 16
        OR R0, R3, R0           ; result_abs = (integer_part << 16) | frac
; Apply sign to result
        POP R4                  ; restore sign from stack
        CMP R4, %D 0
        JR_EQ L14               ; sign == 0 → result 0
        JR_SLT L15              ; sign < 0 → negate
        JP L16                  ; sign > 0 → no change
L14                             ; sign zero
        MOVE %D 0, R0
        JP L16
L15                             ; negate result
        MOVE %D 0, R2
        SUB R2, R0, R0          ; R0 = -R0
L16                             ; sign applied
        MOVE R0, R6             ; return value in R6
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return
L2                              ; division by zero or dividend is zero
        MOVE %D 0, R6           ; return 0 for division by zero or zero dividend
        POP R5                  ; restore frame pointer
        RET                     ; return
